newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Thailand's Amnuay says may accept economics post.
newsitem.headline: Thailand's Amnuay says may accept economics post.

text.p: Thailand's deputy prime minister and minister of foreign affairs Amnuay Viravan said on Monday in Hong Kong "chances are" he would accept the finance minister's post in the Thai coalition government.

"Chances are that I will accept it but will not be able to say definitely until I meet all coalition partners," he told a news conference after speaking at the World Economic Forum meeting in the British colony.
He was responding to questions as to whether he would accept the post of deputy prime minister and finance minister.
